title: Yosef Rishba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 130a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.130a.10), Levi happened to visit the household of Yosef Rishba. They served him a peacock’s head in milk, but he did not eat. When he (Levi) came before Rabbi, Rabbi asked him: “Why did you not excommunicate them?” He replied: “It was the place of Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira,” etc.[^1] In [Chullin 54a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.54a), the household of Yosef Rishba struck (the animal) on the sciatic nerve and killed it; they came before Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira, etc.

notes.text: Hyman writes טוותא; the Shabbat passage has טווסא, “peacock.” Rashi explains רישבא as ציד עופות, “bird hunter.”
